Package com.rpglab.game.game

Class DungeonWorld

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.game.DungeonWorld
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    World
    public class DungeonWorld
extends java.lang.Object
implements World
    Represents the main dungeon world containing all combat scenes and encounters. This class implements the World interface to create a complete dungeon experience with progressively challenging areas and appropriately scaled rewards.

    The dungeon world consists of three main areas:

    • Dungeon Entrance: Contains easier monsters (Slime, Skeleton, Lizardman)
    • Dark Hallway: Features mid-level threats (Dragon, Cockatrice)
    • Monster Lair: Houses the final boss (Demon King)

    Monster statistics and loot quality are dynamically scaled based on the selected difficulty level, ensuring appropriate challenge and rewards for different player skill levels.

    • Constructor Detail

      • DungeonWorld

        public DungeonWorld​(Difficulty Difficulty)
        Constructs a new dungeon world with scenes scaled to the specified difficulty. This constructor creates a complete dungeon experience with three distinct areas, each containing appropriately leveled monsters and loot.

        The difficulty parameter affects:

        • Monster health points (scaled by life multiplier)
        • Monster damage output (scaled by damage multiplier)
        • Loot quality and rarity
        Parameters:
        Difficulty - the difficulty setting that determines monster scaling and loot quality

    • Method Detail

        Specified by:

        Parameters:

      • getScenes

        public CombatScene[] getScenes()

      • newValue

        private int newValue​(int baseValue,
                     double multiplier)
        Calculates a new stat value by applying a difficulty multiplier. This helper method scales monster statistics (health, damage) based on the selected difficulty level to maintain appropriate challenge.
        Parameters:
        baseValue - the original unmodified stat value
        multiplier - the difficulty multiplier to apply
        Returns:
        the scaled stat value as an integer
